name: Tra mat ong gung
summary: Ginger tea sweetened with Thới Sơn honey, poured in the orchard while the musicians play. A Zing account says the hives on the islets of Lân and Phụng feed on longan blossom.
origin: Cù lao Thới Sơn, whose honey is an OCOP product.
howToEat: Drink a cup in the garden with the fruit and the music.
where: The orchards on cù lao Thới Sơn. Cồn Phụng, across the river, sells honey on the Ben Tre side of the same boat day.
seoTitle: Ginger honey tea on Thoi Son
seoDescription: Ginger honey tea in the Thới Sơn orchard, made with the islet’s OCOP honey from longan-blossom hives.
